title: Matrioshka Brains: Star-Powered Computers
summary: Isaac Arthur explains the Matrioshka Brain, a hypothetical computer or artificial mind powered by an entire star using nested shells. It covers how such megastructures relate to Dyson spheres and superintelligence.
why: HN points to it as the accessible introduction to Matrioshka Brains whenever very large computational structures come up.
